description: Source file for Zephyr OS settings subsystem, handling configuration file registration, loading, saving, and management functions.

methods.name: settings_file_src
methods.description: Registers a file as a source of configuration.

methods.name: settings_file_dst
methods.description: Registers a file as a destination of configuration.

methods.name: settings_file_check_duplicate
methods.description: Checks for duplicate configuration entries in the file buffer.

methods.name: settings_file_load_priv
methods.description: Loads configuration entries from file with optional duplicate filtering.

methods.name: settings_tmpfile
methods.description: Creates a temporary filename based on source filename.

methods.name: settings_file_create_or_replace
methods.description: Creates or replaces a configuration file.

methods.name: settings_file_save_and_compress
methods.description: Compresses configuration file by keeping unique entries.

methods.name: settings_file_save_priv
methods.description: Saves a configuration entry to file, with optional compression.

methods.name: settings_file_save
methods.description: Saves a configuration entry, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: get_len_cb
methods.description: Gets length of the file entry.

methods.name: settings_mount_file_backend
methods.description: Mounts the file backend for settings.

methods.name: mkdir_if_not_exists
methods.description: Creates directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: mkdir_for_file
methods.description: Creates necessary directories for a file path.

methods.name: settings_backend_init
methods.description: Initializes the settings backend with file registration and directory setup.

methods.name: settings_file_storage_get
methods.description: Retrieves storage information for a settings file.
